_about: Image-based multibuy recovery (pipeline/multibuy.py), per store. Presence in 'stores' enables the stage for that store: it OCRs the item's wishabi cell render to recover 'N POUR T$' / 'N/T$' offers the Flipp payload collapsed into the bundle total. Enabled on evidence (2026-10-17): kim-phat (flyer 125: 15 of 137 items carried badges; extractor reproduced all 5 campaign hand corrections, zero false positives), metro + metro-plus + super-c (same slash-badge house style, dry-run extractions verified against the printed renders). NOT applicable to Loblaws-chain stores (provigo, maxi, iga): their item images are bare product cutouts with no price graphics — the prints exist only on page renders, which would need a page-crop variant.
